title: Perceptron Launches Ego 1.0 API for Scalable Robot Video Annotations
summary:
A new set of tools for labeling first-person perspective videos is now available to help AI developers create large-scale datasets for robot action models. The newly released Perceptron Egocentric 1.0 API provides a public endpoint for the annotation of egocentric video, featuring 2D and 3D hand tracking and individual timelines for every action performed by a robot gripper or human hand.

The service is intended to solve a bottleneck in the industry's ability to produce high-quality annotations as the volume of egocentric video used in model training increases. Perceptron says the system can match the quality of competing services like Astra while costing approximately 1/8 as much.

Today we officially release Perceptron Ego 1.0, a public endpoint for egocentric annotations. 

With the scale the industry is producing egocentric video, scalable high quality annotations have become a bottleneck. Ego 1.0 is built to achieve frontier performance often matching Astra, while being significantly cheaper. 

We built this API to scale our own action models and now we’re ready to share it. Give it a try or reach out if you’re interested!
